Accepted Retirees::AZ2.formula: IF(OR(AW2="0",AW2="9",AW2="A"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",AY2*100,"% Survivor Annuity",IF(AW2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(AW2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(AX2/12,2),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),IF(AW2="4",CONCATENATE(ROUND(AX2/12,2),"-Year Certain Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity")))

Not Accepted Retirees::BV2.formula: IF(OR(BR2="0",BR2="9",BR2="A"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",BT2*100,"% Survivor", IF(BS2=0," Annuity"," with " & ROUND(BS2/12,0) & "-year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"), IF(BR2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(BR2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(BS2/12,2),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),IF(BR2="4",CONCATENATE(ROUND(BS2/12,2),"-Year Certain Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity")))
